column1: # Widths measured with CoreText for the ru wave audit (mobile.home + mobile.session_health).
# Harness: measure.swift.txt in this bundle, input built from the catalogue JSON.
# PRECISION LIMIT, stated once: Figtree is not installed on this machine, so the sans
# stack falls back to the system face (.AppleSystemUIFont); absolute points are
# therefore approximate. The harness reproduces the repo's OWN recorded measurement
# for the widest Spanish chip (189.4 pt, quoted in src/features/home/home-copy.ts) to
# the tenth of a point, which is why the RATIOS below are used for judgement and the
# absolute numbers only with the headroom each row records.
# cells = 1 per code point, 2 for East-Asian wide/fullwidth (terminal proxy for the
# core's maxCells budgets); cells_ellipsis_wide repeats it with U+2026 at 2 cells.
